prompt: 打开 https://example.com 告诉我页面标题
notes: L1 — every browser task auto-saves the final screenshot as a downloadable file. The blocking assertion reads active task_files output rows and requires image/jpeg; result wording and attachment-link text cannot satisfy it.

prompt: 打开 https://example.com，然后用 save_page_as_pdf 工具把这个页面保存为 PDF，告诉我下载链接。
notes: L2 — explicit prompt tells the agent to invoke save_page_as_pdf. The blocking assertion reads active task_files output rows and requires application/pdf; a claimed download link without the real file now fails.
